body.name: finite-sample empirical-cell totalization
body.construction: For every finite sample, compute \(N_{n,x}\), \(N_{n,x,z}\), and \(N^d_{n,z,x,k}\); use \(\max\{N_{n,x},1\}\) and \(\max\{N_{n,x,z},1\}\) in conditional empirical proportions, assigning zero numerators and hence zero conditional proportions to empty cells. Form \(\widehat w_n\), \(\widehat v_n\), \(\widehat M_n\), \(\widehat N_{L,n}\), and \(\widehat N_{U,n}\) from those proportions, and use the fixed fallback \(\widehat M_n^{\dagger}=1\) when \(\widehat M_n=0\). In the estimated influence vector use \(\max\{N_{n,x,z}/n,1/n\}\) for every empirical joint-cell denominator. These conventions determine the retained faces, multiplier process, generalized-inverse critical value, and \(\mathrm{CI}_n\) on all samples.
